Engram Lineage × Select–Change–Reconstruct

This cross‑map aligns five eras of the engram concept with the three‑stage framework Select → Change → Reconstruct

Era / Thinker Select Change Reconstruct
Semon (1904–1909) - Biological engram & ecphory Salient events/inputs imprint the substrate; choose stimuli and loci of inscription. Synaptic/structural gain; cumulative deposition; law of engraphy. Ecphory: reactivation from stored trace; partial/graded recall.
Jung (1910s–1950s) - Archetypes, collective unconscious Pick archetypal families (circle, tree, spiral, shadow). Morph within latent form‑spaces; symbol amplification & variation. Instantiate motifs in concrete images; recurrence with difference.
Halbwachs (1920s–1940s) - Collective memory Group by social frames (ritual, place, calendar). Apply shared rules/palettes; norming effects of groups. Montage per community; place/time anchors re‑evoke context.
Derrida & Phenomenology (1960s–1990s) - Trace / différance; embodied habit Choose motifs + negatives; what is present/absent. Write/erase cycles; deferred reveal; embodied repetition. Palimpsest ghosts; meaning emerges via thresholds in time.
Neuroscience (2000s–today) - Engram ensembles Detect & tag salient ensembles (features/masks). Reconsolidation: strengthen/attenuate subsets; plastic updates. Selective reactivation sufficient for recall; mix engrams.
